name: Check current integration types
command:
set -e
PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" ./node_modules/.bin/vp run --filter t3 --filter @t3tools/web --filter @t3tools/mobile --filter @t3tools/desktop --filter @t3tools/client-runtime --filter @t3tools/contracts typecheck
git diff --name-only -z upstream/main -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' | xargs -0 -r ./node_modules/.bin/vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives
